title.zh: JDV看什么：确认光罩准备写什么
title.en: What JDV checks: confirm what the mask is about to write

subtitle.zh: 不能只看Die内部，还要检查整张Reticle
subtitle.en: Inspect the entire reticle, not just the die interior

body.zh: Die Array；Frame；Kerf / Scribe Lane；Alignment Mark；PCM / Test Key；Title / Job Info
body.en: Die array Frame Kerf / scribe lane Alignment mark PCM / test key Title / job information
JOB: XXXX REV: A DATE: YYYY-MM-DD LOT: ####

body.zh: Mask完整性 |层数 •Layer名称；检查所有必需层是否存在；Layer名称与顺序是否正确；Assist / Bias / OPC层是否齐全；隐藏层 / 参考层处理是否正确
body.en: Mask completeness | layer count · layer names Are all required layers present? Are layer names and order correct? Are assist / bias / OPC layers complete? Are hidden / reference layers handled correctly?

body.zh: 几何方向|旋转 • 镜像 •阵列；旋转角度是否正确；X/Y镜像是否符合规范；阵列方向与间距是否正确；Die中心与对准标是否一致；旋转；镜像；阵列
body.en: Geometry orientation | rotation · mirroring · array Is the rotation angle correct? Does X/Y mirroring meet the specification? Are array orientation and spacing correct? Is the die center consistent with the alignment marks? Rotation Mirroring Array

body.zh: 制造信息 | Tone · Frame · Job；Tone（Clear / Dark）是否正确；Frame类型与尺寸是否正确；Title / Job / Revision是否正确；特殊要求与备注是否齐全；Tone；Frame；Job Info
body.en: Manufacturing information | tone · frame · job Is clear/dark tone correct? Are frame type and dimensions correct? Are title / job / revision correct? Are special requirements and notes complete? Tone Frame Job information

body.zh: 常见失效 |；Mask缺层•Clear/Dark错误•方向错误•Frame或标题错误
body.en: Common failures | Missing mask layers · wrong clear/dark tone · wrong orientation · wrong frame or title

body.zh: 审查反馈：JDV截图 / Review Checklist / Issue Log / Release Record；JDV截图；Review Checklist；Issue Log；Release Record
body.en: Review feedback: JDV screenshots / review checklist / issue log / release record JDV screenshot Review checklist Issue log Release record

body.zh: JDV显示的底层数据可能因Mask Shop和写版平台而不同。
body.en: JDV underlying data may vary by mask shop and mask-writing platform
